verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents Stencil, a Handlebars-based theme engine for hosted storefronts, as its customizable templating layer. A community user reports running the site locally with live product data, which suggests local preview, though no first-party doc in the pack confirms it. Another hands-on developer calls the templating tag system incomplete and inconsistent, which lowers quality but does not negate the capability. Missing for 10: any evidence of version-controlled or CLI-based theme deploys, first-party documentation of local preview tooling, and depth on templating docs beyond one-line descriptions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can customize storefront code with a documented templating layer, local preview, and version-controlled theme deploys

citations.quote: BigCommerce's Handlebars-based theme engine for building hosted storefronts.
Build with Catalyst (Next.js), customize Stencil themes, or go fully headless with the GraphQL Storefront API.
My favorite feature of BigCommerce was the ability to run the site locally for development, using live product data from the site.
